title: How Sound Bounces Back
thumbnailPrompt: A dramatic, cinematic close-up of sound waves rippling through a cavernous space, subtly illuminating hidden bats using echolocation. The scene is lit with volumetric lighting, creating a sense of mystery and wonder, hinting at the concept of sound bouncing back. High-end documentary style, photorealistic rendering.
infographicPrompts: A clean diagram illustrating sound waves reflecting off different surfaces (smooth, rough, angled) with varying degrees of reflection and absorption. Use arrows to show the path of the sound waves. Modern, high-contrast style.

A conceptual 3D render of a series of switches (representing binary code) arranged like dominoes, triggering a chain reaction. The switches are set against a dark background with bright, focused lighting on the activated switches. Clean, modern style, high-contrast.

A flowchart illustrating the process of echolocation in bats or dolphins. The flowchart should visually depict the emission of sound, reflection off an object, and interpretation of the returning sound wave. Clean, minimalist style with clear visual cues, high-contrast.
